title: Horned Figure by Mystic Tree
description: A person sees a horned black silhouette figure standing in water with glowing blue patterns on its body and long flowing hair. The figure's hands reach toward a large twisted green tree covered in yellow flowers while holding a sheet of music that drips black paint into the reflective water below.
